description: Discover distinct operational workflows from multi-section documents or raw text before compiling. Returns candidate workflows (`id`, `title`, `description`, `sourceIds`) audited by TypeSafe Jev.

authToken.description: Optional session token (`utok_...`) if not passed via Authorization header.

evidenceCoverage.description: Optional document preflight coverage report from the host agent (`pagesExamined`, `totalPages`, `textExtracted`, `tablesExtracted`, `embeddedDiagramsDetected`, `omittedMedia`, `notes`). When omitted media or uninspected diagrams are reported, Unseen flags `EVIDENCE_NOT_INSPECTED`.

granularity.description: Hierarchy detail hint: 'overview' (parent + phases summary), 'subprocess', or 'all' (default).

sources.description: Array of source excerpts `{id, locator, excerpt, modality?, confidence?}` from the document.

text.description: Optional raw document text if `sources` is not pre-segmented.

name: detect_workflows
title: Detect Candidate Workflows in Document
